title: Certificate verdict machine
statement: For a natural number $k$ and a designated work-tape index $c$ among the $k$ tapes, define a three-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols. It starts in state $0$; in state $0$ it moves the head on tape $c$ one cell left and enters state $1$. In state $1$, if the scanned symbol on tape $c$ is true, it again moves that head one cell left and enters state $2$; otherwise it outputs false and halts. In state $2$, it outputs true exactly when the scanned cell on tape $c$ is blank, and halts. In every step the input head stays put, and no work-tape cell is written.
